R27.lead: فقط به سؤال‌هایی جواب دهید که برای شما مهم است. باقی همه باز می‌ماند.
R27.openNowOnly: فقط جاهایی که اکنون باز است
R27.langHint: جاهایی را نشان می‌دهد که کسی به آن زبان صحبت می‌کند. جاهایی که به ما نگفته‌اند، نشان داده نمی‌شوند.
R27.noIdHint: فقط جاهایی را نشان می‌دهد که به مرکز گفته‌اند برای کمک به شما تذکره، اسناد یا وضعیت مهاجرت را نمی‌پرسند. جاهایی که به ما نگفته‌اند نشان داده نمی‌شوند، تا شما داخل نروید و از شما پرسیده نشود.
R27.private: جواب‌های شما در همین تلفون می‌ماند. ذخیره نمی‌شود و به هیچ کس فرستاده نمی‌شود.

R28.title: «تأیید شده» یعنی چه
R28.body: تأیید شده یعنی یک نفر در مرکز، یا در یک سازمان همکار که مرکز با آن کار می‌کند، پیش از فرستادن این هشدار، آن را با کسانی که در محل هستند بررسی کرده است.
R28.notYet: هنوز تأیید نشده یعنی هشدار از یک سفیر ساختمان آمده است، که اکثراً اولین کسی است که خبر می‌شود. مرکز آن را هر قدر زود که بتواند بررسی می‌کند.
R28.official: هشدارهای رسمی از {source} می‌آیند و بدون تغییر کلمه‌های آن‌ها رسانده می‌شوند.
R28.notFalse: هنوز تأیید نشده به این معنی نیست که غلط است.
R28.ambFirst: این هشدار اول {t} توسط یک سفیر ساختمان در {building} نشر شد.
R28.ambPosted: این هشدار {t} توسط یک سفیر ساختمان در {building} نشر شد.
R28.notYetAct: شما می‌توانید همین حالا مطابق آن عمل کنید. وقتی مرکز آن را بررسی کرد، به جای آن «تأیید شده توسط مرکز» نوشته می‌شود.
R28.correctedLine: این هشدار {t} اصلاح شد. هشدار نشان می‌دهد که چه تغییر کرد، و متن قبلی قابل خواندن می‌ماند.
R28.officialAdds: مرکز هرگز کلمه‌های یک هشدار رسمی را تغییر نمی‌دهد. شاید در یک هشدار اجتماعی جداگانه اضافه کند که در ساختمان شما چه می‌گذرد.
R28.legendVerified: یک نفر در مرکز یا یک همکار پیش از فرستادن آن را بررسی کرد.
R28.legendUnverified: یک سفیر ساختمان نشر کرده است. مرکز هنوز آن را بررسی نکرده است.
R28.legendOfficial: از یک منبع دولتی، کلمه به کلمه رسانده شده است.

R29.title: این هشدار را شریک کنید
R29.everyone: همه همین نسخه را می‌گیرند. هیچ چیزی که مخصوص شما است شریک نمی‌شود.
R29.notRecorded: CVH ثبت نمی‌کند که چه کسی هشدارها را شریک می‌کند یا شما آن‌ها را به چه کسی می‌فرستید.
R29.handed: گزینه‌های شریک کردن تلفون شما اینجا باز می‌شد.
R29.lead: همسایه‌های شما هشدار را همان طوری که مرکز نوشته است می‌گیرند، همراه با منبع آن و لینک تازه‌ترین نسخه.
R29.sendLine: تلفون شما می‌پرسد که با کدام اپلیکیشن آن را بفرستید.
R29.copied: [EN] Copied. You can paste it into any app.
R29.copyFailed: [EN] Your phone would not copy it. Press and hold the message above to copy it.
R29.noSheet: [EN] Your phone does not offer share options here. Copy the message, or send it on WhatsApp.

R30.openedLater: بعداً باز شد: تازه‌ترین خبر و یک اصلاح را نشان می‌دهد.
R30.askLine: آیا برق کس دیگری هم قطع است؟
R30.askLineOther: آیا کسی می‌داند که لفت را چه شده است؟
R30.openLater: لینک را چند ساعت بعد باز کنید
R30.senderLang: {name} CVH را به {lang} می‌خواند. لینک به زبان کسی باز می‌شود که آن را باز می‌کند، نه به زبان فرستنده.
R30.linkRemovedNote: لینک برداشته شد. پیام هنوز هم می‌گوید که چه شد، در کجا، از طرف کی است، تأیید شده است یا نه، چه وقت، و چه باید کرد.
R30.sinceSent: از وقتی که {name} این را فرستاد:
R30.noChange: بعداً باز شد: از وقت فرستادن این پیام، چیز تازه‌ای نشر نشده است.
R30.nowVerified: بعداً باز شد: مرکز از آن وقت تا حالا این پیام را بررسی کرده است، پس هشدار اکنون «تأیید شده توسط مرکز» می‌گوید.
R30.exNote: تمرین. اگر یک پیام تمرینی به دیگران فرستاده شود، کلمه تمرین به حیث سطر اول با آن می‌رود، تا هیچ کس آن را هشدار واقعی فکر نکند.

R31.title: شماره‌هایی که شاید به آن‌ها نیاز داشته باشم
R31.emergencyWhen: اگر زندگی یا امنیت کسی همین حالا در خطر است، به 911 زنگ بزنید: آتش‌سوزی، یک حالت عاجل صحی، یا جرمی که همین حالا رخ می‌دهد.
R31.p211: کمک برای پیدا کردن خدمات اجتماعی و دولتی
R31.p311: خدمات شاروالی تورنتو و مشکلات غیر اضطراری
R31.hydro: قطع برق را به Toronto Hydro گزارش دهید
R31.hub: با یک نفر در مرکز صحبت کنید
R31.noBuilding: ما هنوز شماره تماسی برای ساختمان شما نداریم. سفیر طبقه شما کمک کرده می‌تواند.
R31.callConfirm: در CVH واقعی، این کار به {number} زنگ می‌زد.
R31.lead: هر شماره مطابق کاری که برای آن است درج شده است.
R31.noBuildingNoAmb: ما هنوز شماره تماسی برای ساختمان شما نداریم. مرکز کمک کرده می‌تواند تا با مدیریت ساختمان خود تماس بگیرید.
R31.noBuildingChosen: ساختمان خود را انتخاب کنید. وقتی شماره تماس آن را داشته باشیم، اینجا نشان می‌دهیم. تا آن وقت، مرکز کمک کرده می‌تواند.
R31.ambRoute: او در ساختمان شما زندگی می‌کند و می‌تواند چیزها را به مدیریت ساختمان برساند.
R31.hubHours: باز است: دوشنبه تا پنج‌شنبه 9 صبح تا 8 شب، جمعه 9 صبح تا 5 عصر، شنبه 10 صبح تا 2 بعد از ظهر
R31.checked: مرکز بررسی کرده است، آخرین تغییر {date}
R31.noOthers: شماره‌های دیگر همین حالا بارگذاری نشدند. چند دقیقه بعد دوباره کوشش کنید.

R32.title: یک اطلاع قبلی پیش از هر فصل
R32.lead: یک یادآوری کوتاه در CVH پیش از گرمی هوا، دود و قطع برق زمستان، با یک یا دو کاری که باید بکنید.
R32.never: اطلاع‌های قبلی فقط در CVH نشان داده می‌شوند. هرگز با پیام کوتاه نمی‌آیند.
R32.switchLabel: پیش از هر فصل به من یک اطلاع قبلی نشان دهید

titles.smoke: پیش از فصل دود آتش‌سوزی جنگل

R32.turnedOn: اطلاع قبلی روشن است. آن را در صفحه «اکنون» می‌بینید، فقط در CVH.
R32.turnedOff: اطلاع قبلی خاموش است. هیچ چیز دیگری تغییر نکرده است.
R32.offLine: اطلاع قبلی تا وقتی که آن را روشن نکنید، خاموش است.
R32.whereLine: در صفحه «اکنون»، چند هفته پیش از هر فصل نشان داده می‌شوند.

R33.title: احوال‌پرسی بخواهید
R33.what: وقتی در ساختمان شما هشدار گرمی هوا یا قطع برق باشد، سفیر طبقه شما از شما احوال می‌پرسد، و می‌تواند کمک کند تا به خدماتی که نیاز دارید برسید.
R33.how: چطور می‌خواهید احوال شما پرسیده شود؟
R33.unitWhy: ما شماره آپارتمان شما را فقط برای این می‌پرسیم تا سفیر شما بداند کدام دروازه را تک‌تک کند.
R33.noAmbassador: هنوز در طبقه {floor} سفیر طبقه نیست، پس ما وعده احوال‌پرسی داده نمی‌توانیم.
R33.hubInstead: به جای آن به مرکز به شماره {phone} زنگ بزنید. ما {hours} باز هستیم.
R33.requestedBody: وقتی در {building} هشدار گرمی هوا یا قطع برق باشد، سفیر طبقه شما از راه {method} از شما احوال می‌پرسد.
R33.withdrawn: احوال‌پرسی قطع شد. شما هنوز هم هشدارها را می‌گیرید.
R33.helper: من به کسی کمک می‌کنم. او موافقت کرده است که احوال‌پرسی خواسته شود.
R33.askPlace: ما به ساختمان و طبقه شما نیاز داریم تا بدانیم آیا یک سفیر طبقه از شما احوال پرسیده می‌تواند.
R33.covered: یک سفیر طبقه، طبقه {floor} را پوشش می‌دهد.
R33.stillAlerts: شما هنوز هم همه هشدارهای ساختمان خود را می‌گیرید.
R33.needMethod: انتخاب کنید که چطور می‌خواهید احوال شما پرسیده شود.
R33.needUnit: برای تک‌تک کردن دروازه، شماره آپارتمان خود را اضافه کنید، یا زنگ تلفونی یا پیام کوتاه را انتخاب کنید.
R33.needHelper: لطفاً اول از او بپرسید. وقتی موافقت کرد، در چوکات علامه بگذارید.
R33.needPlace: اول ساختمان و طبقه خود را انتخاب کنید.
R33.howWithdraw: شما هر وقت می‌توانید احوال‌پرسی را قطع کنید: اینجا، در «انتخاب‌های من»، یا با جواب دادن NOCHECK به یک پیام کوتاه از مرکز.
R33.helping: در این کار به کسی کمک می‌کنید؟

R34.title: آنچه به CVH گفته‌ام
R34.lead: فقط آنچه خودتان انتخاب کردید. هر چیزی را اینجا تغییر دهید یا بردارید. تغییرها فوراً اجرا می‌شوند.
R34.removed: برداشته شد. این از همین حالا اجرا می‌شود.
R34.nothing: شما هنوز چیزی به CVH نگفته‌اید.
R34.onDevice: این انتخاب‌ها فقط در همین دستگاه نگهداری می‌شوند.
R34.invite: برای گرفتن هشدارهای ساختمان و گروه‌های خود در تلفون، هشدار با پیام کوتاه را فعال کنید. یک دقیقه وقت می‌گیرد و به حساب کاربری نیاز ندارد.
R34.inviteYes: هشدار با پیام کوتاه را فعال کنید
R34.fromTailored: مشوره زیر «این برای شما یعنی چه» فقط از انتخاب‌های همین صفحه می‌آید. آن‌ها را اینجا تغییر دهید، مشوره هم تغییر می‌کند.
R34.setByHelper: کسی که به شما کمک می‌کند روشن کرد
R34.checkinNoAmb: هنوز در طبقه شما سفیر طبقه نیست. به جای آن مرکز کمک کرده می‌تواند.
R34.unitLine: آپارتمان {unit}، فقط برای تک‌تک کردن دروازه
R34.howStop: برای قطع، در جواب هر پیام کوتاه مرکز STOP بفرستید.
R34.langNote: زبانی که CVH را به آن می‌خوانید.
R34.removedBuildingOne: 1 ساختمانی که ذخیره کرده بودید دیگر در فهرست ساختمان‌ها نیست، پس برداشته شد.
R34.removedBuildingMany: {n} ساختمانی که ذخیره کرده بودید دیگر در فهرست ساختمان‌ها نیستند، پس برداشته شدند.
R34.removedFloorOne: 1 طبقه‌ای که ذخیره کرده بودید دیگر وجود ندارد، پس برداشته شد.
R34.removedFloorMany: {n} طبقه‌ای که ذخیره کرده بودید دیگر وجود ندارند، پس برداشته شدند.
R34.removedRest: باقی انتخاب‌های شما تغییر نکرده است.
R34.clearTitle: همه چیز از این تلفون پاک شود؟
R34.clearBody: این کار زبان، گروه‌ها، ساختمان‌ها و طبقه‌های شما را از این تلفون پاک می‌کند. شما دوباره با انتخاب یک زبان شروع می‌کنید.
R34.listFailed: فهرست ساختمان‌ها همین حالا بارگذاری نشد. انتخاب‌های شما هنوز ذخیره است.
R34.offlineHelp: صفحه‌هایی که با سیگنال باز می‌کنید در این تلفون ذخیره می‌شوند، تا بعداً بدون سیگنال دوباره آن‌ها را بخوانید. شماره‌ها همیشه ذخیره هستند. بار اول، CVH برای باز شدن به سیگنال نیاز دارد.
R34.offlineNote: ممکن است این تلفون صفحه‌ها را برای استفاده بدون سیگنال نگه ندارد

R35.title: هشدارهای ساختمان خود را بگیرید
R35.lead: جایی را که زندگی می‌کنید انتخاب کنید تا هشدارهای ساختمان خود را اول ببینید. هر قدم اختیاری است.
R35.floorLine: اگر طبقه را انتخاب کنید، هشدارهایی را هم می‌گیرید که فقط برای طبقه شما است، مانند خرابی لفت یا قطع آب.
R35.noUnit: ما اینجا هرگز شماره آپارتمان شما را نمی‌پرسیم.
R35.skipLine: اگر از این بگذرید، هنوز هم همه هشدارهای محله خود را می‌بینید.
R35.invite: برای گرفتن هشدارهای ساختمان، طبقه و گروه‌های خود در تلفون، هشدار با پیام کوتاه را فعال کنید. یک دقیقه وقت می‌گیرد و به حساب کاربری نیاز ندارد.
R35.inviteYes: هشدار با پیام کوتاه را فعال کنید
R35.helper: من به کسی کمک می‌کنم. او با این انتخاب موافقت کرده است.
R35.more: {n} ساختمان دیگر. برای پیدا کردن ساختمان خود، بخشی از آدرس را بنویسید.
R35.nextCheckin: بعدی: چطور می‌خواهید احوال شما پرسیده شود.
R35.helperNeeded: لطفاً اول از او بپرسید. وقتی موافقت کرد، در چوکات علامه بگذارید، یا از این سؤال بگذرید.
R35.saved: ذخیره شد. این از همین حالا اجرا می‌شود.
R35.nothingSummary: هنوز هیچ چیز. شما همه هشدارهای تورنکلیف پارک و فلمینگدن پارک را می‌بینید.
R35.manyLine: ساختمان خود یا ساختمان یکی از خویشاوندان خود را انتخاب کنید. هر قدر که بخواهید انتخاب کرده می‌توانید.
R35.noFloorsListed: هنوز هیچ طبقه‌ای برای این ساختمان درج نشده است.
R35.loadFailed: فهرست ساختمان‌ها بارگذاری نشد. اتصال خود را ببینید و دوباره کوشش کنید، یا از این قدم بگذرید.

A02.lineRequired: در یک سطر بگویید که چه پیش آمده است

elevator.action: [EN] Use the stairs with care. Your floor ambassador can help bring things up.

fire.action: [EN] If you hear the alarm, leave by the stairs. Do not use the elevator.

errors.unavailable: [EN] The authenticator is not working right now. Try again in a few minutes.

buildings.title: [EN] Buildings and floors
buildings.lead: [EN] The pilot buildings come from the City of Toronto register. For each one, check the floors, correct any label that is wrong, then mark the building confirmed.
buildings.empty: [EN] No buildings have been imported yet. Ask IT to run the buildings seed.
buildings.notInRegisterLine: [EN] The latest import did not find this building in the City register. It is kept as it is. Check whether it still belongs in the pilot.
buildings.floorsLead: [EN] From the lowest floor up. Rename a floor to correct its label: its assignments stay with it. Remove a floor that does not exist, like a missing 13.
buildings.noFloors: [EN] This building has no floors yet.
buildings.floorLabel: [EN] Label of the floor now called {label}
buildings.removeConfirm: [EN] Remove floor {label}? This cannot be undone.

add.title: [EN] Add a floor
add.label: [EN] Label
add.hint: [EN] Up to 8 letters, digits, spaces or hyphens, like G, L, P1 or 14.

confirm.title: [EN] Confirm this building

errors.labelEmpty: [EN] Enter a label for the floor.
errors.labelTooLong: [EN] A label can have at most 8 characters.
errors.labelCharacters: [EN] Use only letters, digits, spaces and hyphens in a label, with at least one letter or digit.
errors.labelDuplicate: [EN] This building already has a floor with that label. Labels count as the same when they differ only by capital letters or spaces.
errors.floorHasAssignments: [EN] Reassign or remove the ambassadors on this floor first
errors.noChange: [EN] Nothing to change: the floor already has that label.
errors.noFloors: [EN] Add at least one floor before confirming the building.

errors.notWorkNumber: [EN] Confirm that this is a work or office number the building agreed to publish.
errors.contactNoChange: [EN] Nothing to change: the contact is already saved like this.

contact.lead: [EN] A work or office number residents can call about this building. The Hub provides it, and residents see it on the building page with the date you save it.
contact.current: [EN] Provided by the Hub, last updated {date}
contact.none: [EN] No contact entered yet. Residents see "Not known".
contact.workNumber: [EN] This is a work or office number the building agreed to publish.

coverage.summary: [EN] Buildings with every floor covered: {covered} of {total}. Floors without an ambassador: {gaps}.
coverage.empty: [EN] No buildings have been imported yet. Ask IT to run the buildings seed.
coverage.noFloors: [EN] No floors are listed for this building yet.
coverage.noAssignments: [EN] No ambassador is assigned to this building.

inactive.locked_pending_reissue: [EN] the account is locked until an Admin re-issues the starting password
inactive.notAmbassador: [EN] the account is no longer an ambassador

coverage.removeConfirm: [EN] Remove {name} from this building? They stay an ambassador and stop covering it.

assign.noAmbassadors: [EN] There is no active ambassador to assign. Add one under People first.
assign.all: [EN] All floors, including floors added later
assign.range: [EN] Or every floor from one to another, as the building lists its floors now (floors added later are not included)
assign.noFloors: [EN] Add floors to this building before assigning an ambassador to some of them.

errors.forbidden: [EN] Only an Admin, a Coordinator or a Director can see coverage.
errors.assignForbidden: [EN] Only an Admin can assign ambassadors.
errors.aal2Required: [EN] An Admin must sign in with their authenticator code to assign ambassadors. Sign in again and enter the code.
errors.accountNotFound: [EN] That person does not exist. Reload the page.
errors.notAmbassador: [EN] Only an ambassador can be assigned to a building.
errors.accountNotActive: [EN] That ambassador is not active, so they cannot be assigned.

errors.floorNotInBuilding: [EN] One of those floors is not a floor of this building. Reload the page.
errors.rangeIncomplete: [EN] Choose both ends of the range of floors, or neither.
errors.notAssigned: [EN] That ambassador is not assigned to this building.
errors.chooseScope: [EN] Choose which floors: all floors, or only the floors you pick.
errors.allWithFloors: [EN] You chose all floors but also picked floors or a range. Choose all floors on their own, or choose only the floors you pick.

ambassadorHome.title: [EN] My building
ambassadorHome.lead: [EN] What residents are reading about your buildings, and the updates you have posted.
ambassadorHome.assignedAll: [EN] You are the ambassador for {building}, all floors.
ambassadorHome.assignedFloors: [EN] You are the ambassador for {building}, floors {floors}.
ambassadorHome.notAssigned: [EN] You are not assigned to a building. The Hub will assign you, and this page then shows your buildings.
ambassadorHome.postsNone: [EN] You have not posted an update yet.

states.returned: [EN] Sent back to you by the Hub

ambassadorHome.roundNone: [EN] No check-in round right now. It starts when the Hub sends a heat or power alert for your building.
ambassadorHome.drillsLead: [EN] Practice only. What you post here goes to the Hub, never to residents.

ambassadorPost.hubNote: [EN] Building ambassadors post updates for their buildings here. Hub staff log a disruption from the Hub's home.

audience.placeTitle: [EN] Who is this alert for? The place
audience.groupsTitle: [EN] Who is this alert for? The groups
audience.placeLead: [EN] Choose a whole neighbourhood, or some buildings and, in each, the whole building or only some floors.
audience.groupsLead: [EN] Texts can be narrowed to the groups residents chose to join. Choose none to text everyone in the place.
audience.scopeNeighbourhoodLine: [EN] Everyone who lives there is included.
audience.scopeBuildingsLine: [EN] Only the buildings you choose, with the whole building or some floors of each.
audience.buildingsHint: [EN] Tick each building, then choose its whole building or some of its floors.
audience.range: [EN] Or every floor from one to another, in the order the building lists them
audience.noFloorsListed: [EN] No floors are listed for this building, so only the whole building can be chosen.
audience.noFloorNote: [EN] Residents who did not say which floor they live on in a building you chose floors for get it too.
audience.groupsChosen: [EN] Groups chosen: {groups}. Texts go only to residents who chose one of them.
audience.noGroupsChosen: [EN] No group chosen: texts go to everyone in the place.
audience.groupsHint: [EN] Groups are what residents chose to tell the CVH. Someone in two of the groups you choose gets one text.
audience.groupsWeb: [EN] Groups narrow who is texted. Everyone who opens the web app can still see the alert.

groupLines.families: [EN] Households with babies or young children.
groupLines.checkin: [EN] Residents who asked for a check-in during heat and outages.

audience.missing: [EN] That alert draft was not found. Open it again from the list of alerts.
audience.locked: [EN] This alert was already submitted, so who it is for cannot change. Pull it back to a draft first.

errors.forbidden: [EN] Only a Coordinator or an Admin can choose who an alert is for.
errors.chooseScope: [EN] Choose a neighbourhood or some buildings.
errors.bothScopes: [EN] You chose a neighbourhood and also ticked buildings. Choose one or the other.
errors.allWithFloors: [EN] You chose a whole building but also picked floors or a range for it. Choose the whole building on its own, or choose only the floors you pick.
errors.floorsWithoutBuilding: [EN] You picked floors in a building that is not ticked. Tick the building, or clear its floors.
errors.empty: [EN] Nothing is chosen. Choose at least one neighbourhood, one building, or for a building its whole building or at least one floor.
errors.floorNotInBuilding: [EN] One of those floors is not a floor of that building. Reload the page and choose again.
errors.rangeReversed: [EN] A range goes from a higher floor to a lower one. Put the lower floor first.
errors.rangeIncomplete: [EN] Choose both ends of the range of floors, or neither.
errors.buildingNotFound: [EN] One of those buildings does not exist. Reload the page.
errors.neighbourhoodNotFound: [EN] That neighbourhood does not exist. Reload the page.
errors.groupUnknown: [EN] One of those groups does not exist. Reload the page.
errors.neighbourhoodOnlyType: [EN] Heat, smoke and winter storm alerts go to a whole neighbourhood, not to buildings. Choose a neighbourhood.
errors.notAllowed: [EN] Only a Coordinator or an Admin can choose a neighbourhood, or send a heat, smoke or winter storm alert.
errors.outOfScope: [EN] You are not assigned to one of those buildings.
errors.notFound: [EN] That alert draft was not found.
errors.notDraft: [EN] This alert was already submitted, so who it is for cannot change.
errors.invalid: [EN] That audience cannot be used. Reload the page and choose again.

audience.changeUnlistedBuilding: [EN] a building that is not in the list
audience.changeOutsideGroups: [EN] residents who chose none of the groups

time.foldLegend: [EN] Before or after the clock change
time.foldQuestion: [EN] {time} happens twice on {date}, because the clocks go back. Do you mean before or after the clock change?
time.invalid: [EN] Enter a date and a time.
time.nonexistent: [EN] That time does not exist in Toronto: the clocks go forward on that night and skip it. Enter another time.

log.title: [EN] Log a disruption
log.lead: [EN] Say what is happening, where, and when the first report reached the Hub. The acknowledgement is written for you on the next screen.
log.alertLead: [EN] Say what is happening, where, and when the first report reached the Hub. You write the alert on the next screen.
log.benchmark: [EN] Aim: the acknowledgement out within 5 to 10 minutes of the first report. It is a team aim, not a promise.
log.nbhdOnlyHint: [EN] Heat, smoke and winter storms are raised for a neighbourhood, not for buildings.
log.placeHint: [EN] A whole neighbourhood, or buildings and, in each, the whole building or only some floors.
log.whenTitle: [EN] 3. When did the first report reach the Hub?
log.whenHint: [EN] In Toronto time. It cannot be later than now.
log.forbidden: [EN] Only a Coordinator or an Admin can log a disruption.

errors.chooseType: [EN] Choose at least one type of disruption.
errors.typesRepeated: [EN] A type was chosen twice. Reload the page and choose again.
errors.unknownType: [EN] That type of disruption does not exist. Reload the page.
errors.futureTime: [EN] The first report cannot be later than now.
errors.invalid: [EN] That disruption could not be logged. Reload the page and try again.

log.drillLead: [EN] Say what the exercise is about, where, and when. The acknowledgement is written for you on the next screen. Everything started here is marked as an exercise, and its texts go only to the drill roster.
log.drillBenchmark: [EN] Practice only: no resident gets anything from a drill.
log.drillForbidden: [EN] Only an Admin can start a drill.
log.drillAal2Required: [EN] An Admin must sign in with their authenticator code to start a drill. Sign in again and enter the code.

compose.ackLead: [EN] The acknowledgement starts from suggested wording for the type and the place. Read it, change it if you need to, then submit it for a second person to approve.
compose.alertLead: [EN] Write what residents need to know now. A second person approves it before anyone sees it.
compose.benchmark: [EN] Aim: out within 5 to 10 minutes of the first report.
compose.textHint: [EN] At most {max} characters. It is translated into every launch language when you submit, and you cannot edit a translation.
compose.validResolved: [EN] Until resolved: 24 hours from now, renewed by each update
compose.validAt: [EN] Until a date and a time
compose.validHint: [EN] At most 7 days ahead. Staff enter it in Toronto time. You can change it with any update.
compose.previewLead: [EN] The exact text residents who read English will get, made by the one text-message renderer: {segments} segment(s), {encoding}. A drill or a correction would add its marker first.
compose.preview911First: [EN] For fire alarms and evacuation, and for "Other", the 911 line comes first.
compose.preview911Last: [EN] The 911 line comes after the text.
compose.languagesLead: [EN] When you submit, the text is translated into each of these, checked for language and script, and frozen with the text messages. A language that cannot be checked shows the English text with "Translation not available".
compose.channelWeb: [EN] Web app: in every launch language, once a second person approves it.
compose.channelSms: [EN] Text messages: the exact texts are frozen when you submit. They go out once texting is live.
compose.missing: [EN] That alert draft was not found. Open it again from the Hub.

running.title: [EN] Preparing your alert
running.lead: [EN] Translating into every language and rendering the text messages. This takes up to {seconds} seconds. You can leave this page: it carries on, and what happened will be here when you come back.
running.leadUnknown: [EN] Translating into every language and rendering the text messages. This can take up to a minute. You can leave this page: it carries on, and what happened will be here when you come back.
running.lost: [EN] We lost the connection before we saw the result. Checking what happened.
running.notReached: [EN] We could not confirm that the request reached the server, so we do not know yet whether the alert was submitted. Press Submit for approval again: it sends the same request, so the alert cannot be submitted twice.

result.fallback_en: [EN] Not translated: English with "Translation not available"

committed.title: [EN] Submitted for approval
committed.lead: [EN] Version {version}. A second person has to approve it before residents see it. You cannot approve what you wrote or changed.
committed.fellBack: [EN] {n} of {total} languages could not be translated, so they show the English text with "Translation not available": {languages}.
committed.retryNote: [EN] Returns the alert to a draft, translates it again and submits it as a new version. You will not be able to approve it.
committed.pullBackNote: [EN] Returns it to a draft so you can change it. It needs a new submit.
committed.duplicate: [EN] This may duplicate another open alert for the same place and type. The approver is shown a link to it. A duplicate is withdrawn with the reason "duplicate".

locked.approved: [EN] This alert was approved and is published.

returned.title: [EN] Sent back to you
returned.lead: [EN] An approver sent this alert back with a note. Change what it asks for, then submit it again.

suggest.several: [EN] Several things are wrong{on}: {list}. We are finding out more. More information to come.

errors.DRAFT_CHANGED: [EN] This alert changed while it was being prepared. Submit again.
errors.ROUTES_UNAVAILABLE: [EN] The translation settings could not be read, so nothing was translated and nothing was submitted. The alert is still a draft. Try again in a minute, and tell IT if it keeps happening.
errors.ROUTES_INVALID: [EN] The translation settings are not valid, so nothing was translated and nothing was submitted. The alert is still a draft. Tell IT.
errors.SMS_BODY_TOO_LONG: [EN] A translation made a text message too long to send, so nothing was submitted. Shorten the English text and submit again.
errors.TRANSLATION_STALE: [EN] The text changed while it was being translated, so nothing was submitted. Submit again.
errors.PREPARATION_FAILED: [EN] The alert could not be prepared, so nothing was submitted. It is still a draft. Try again.
errors.SUBMIT_IN_PROGRESS: [EN] This alert is already being submitted. Wait for it to finish.
errors.SUBMIT_ABANDONED: [EN] The earlier attempt did not finish, so nothing was submitted. Submit again.
errors.SUBMIT_KEY_INVALID: [EN] That submit could not be made. Reload the page and try again.
errors.VALID_UNTIL_PAST: [EN] The valid-until time has passed. Choose a time in the future.
errors.VALID_UNTIL_TOO_FAR: [EN] The valid-until time is more than 7 days away. Choose a time within 7 days.
errors.VALID_UNTIL_INVALID: [EN] Enter a valid-until date and time.
errors.TEXT_EMPTY: [EN] Write the text of the alert.
errors.TEXT_TOO_LONG: [EN] The text is too long: at most {max} characters.
errors.TYPES_REPEATED: [EN] A type was chosen twice. Reload the page and choose again.
errors.NEIGHBOURHOOD_ONLY_TYPE: [EN] Heat, smoke and winter storm alerts go to a whole neighbourhood, not to buildings. Change the place to a neighbourhood first.
errors.NOT_ALLOWED: [EN] You cannot change or submit this alert.
errors.AUTHOR_NOT_ALLOWED: [EN] You cannot change or submit this alert.
errors.OUT_OF_SCOPE: [EN] Only the author, or someone who has changed this alert, can submit it.
errors.ILLEGAL_TRANSITION: [EN] This alert is not a draft, so it cannot be changed or submitted.
errors.WEB_PUBLISHED: [EN] This alert is already published, so it cannot be changed. Correct it instead.
errors.ENTRY_NOT_PENDING: [EN] This alert is not waiting for approval.
errors.ENTRY_CHANGED: [EN] This alert changed. Reload the page to see it.
errors.ALERT_NOT_FOUND: [EN] That alert draft was not found.
errors.ENTRY_NOT_FOUND: [EN] That alert draft was not found.
errors.NO_PUBLISHED_ENTRY: [EN] Nothing is published in this alert yet, so there is nothing to add an update to. Wait for its approval first.
errors.ENTRY_ID_INVALID: [EN] That update could not be started. Reload the page and try again.
errors.TYPES_CHANGED: [EN] An update keeps the types of the alert. To report something else, log a new disruption.
errors.AUDIENCE_INVALID: [EN] Who this alert is for is not valid. Change the place and the groups, then try again.
errors.BUILDING_NOT_FOUND: [EN] One of the buildings no longer exists. Change the place.
errors.FLOOR_NOT_IN_BUILDING: [EN] One of the floors no longer exists. Change the place.
errors.NEIGHBOURHOOD_NOT_FOUND: [EN] That neighbourhood does not exist. Change the place.
errors.forbidden: [EN] Only a Coordinator or an Admin can write an alert.
errors.invalid: [EN] That could not be done. Reload the page and try again.
errors.TARGET_NOT_VALID: [EN] That entry is not one that can be corrected or withdrawn. Go back and choose again.
errors.TARGET_SUPERSEDED: [EN] That entry was corrected or withdrawn already. Go back and read the alert as it is now.
errors.TARGET_NOT_PUBLISHED: [EN] Residents have not read that entry, so there is nothing to correct or withdraw. Wait for its approval, or discard it.
errors.WITHDRAWAL_REASON_INVALID: [EN] Choose why you are withdrawing it.
errors.replaceForbidden: [EN] Only a Coordinator or an Admin can correct or withdraw an alert.
errors.replaceAal2: [EN] Correcting or withdrawing needs a sign-in confirmed with your authenticator. Sign out, sign in again and enter your code.

compose.updateLead: [EN] Add what we know now to this alert. Residents see it above the earlier entries, which stay as they are. A second person approves it before anyone sees it.
compose.promoteLead: [EN] This is the first update to the acknowledgement. The same alert is updated for everyone who has it: nothing is sent as a new alert. A second person approves it before anyone sees it.
compose.startNote: [EN] Saving makes the draft. Then you can change who it is for, read the text message and submit it for approval.

thread.title: [EN] The running alert
thread.lead: [EN] What residents read now, newest first. Your update is added at the top: nothing here is replaced.
thread.leadReplace: [EN] What residents read now, newest first. A correction is added above the entry it corrects. A withdrawal puts the reason in the place of the entry. Nothing is deleted.
thread.leadResolve: [EN] What residents read now, newest first. Your final entry is added at the top and closes the alert: nothing here is deleted.

compose.carried: [EN] Who it is for, the types and the languages are carried over from the alert. Change who it is for with the links below: the approver sees what changes.
compose.carriedStart: [EN] Who it is for, the types and the languages are carried over from the alert. Save the draft first, then change who it is for if you need to.
compose.sameAudience: [EN] Who it is for is the same as the alert now.
compose.phaseRequired: [EN] Required: choose where things stand now.
compose.updateClosed: [EN] This alert is already closed. Nothing more can be added to it.
compose.updateUnpublished: [EN] Nothing is published in this alert yet, so there is nothing to add an update to. Wait for its approval first.
compose.correctLead: [EN] A correction is added to the same alert in the open. The earlier wording stays readable, marked "Corrected", and residents see what changed. A second person approves it before anyone sees it.
compose.withdrawLead: [EN] Residents see "Withdrawn" and the reason in the place of the entry. A second person approves it before anyone sees it. If nothing else in the alert is left, the alert closes as withdrawn.
compose.targetsLead: [EN] These are the entries residents can read now. One that was corrected or withdrawn already is not here.
compose.targetsNone: [EN] No entry of this alert can be corrected or withdrawn now.
compose.withdrawWordsHint: [EN] Residents read the reason in the place of the entry, in their language. Add words of your own, or write the whole reason if you chose "Other". At most {max} characters.
compose.withdrawReasonHint: [EN] Residents see that the entry was withdrawn, with this reason.
compose.withdrawTextLabel: [EN] What residents read in the place of the entry
compose.withdrawTextHint: [EN] The reason, in English. It is translated into every language when you submit. At most {max} characters.
compose.withdrawCarried: [EN] Who it is for is who the withdrawn entry was for, and everyone who got that entry also gets this withdrawal.
compose.resolveLead: [EN] Resolving closes the alert with a final word. Nothing is deleted from residents' view: the alert moves to alerts that have ended with its whole thread. A second person approves the final message before anyone sees it.
compose.resolveTextHint: [EN] One or two short sentences: what is fixed, and what to do if it is not fixed for you. At most {max} characters.
compose.resolveStartNote: [EN] Saving makes the draft. Then you can read the text message and submit it for approval. Approving it closes the alert.
compose.resolveCarried: [EN] Who it is for is who the alert is for now. Everyone who got any entry of this alert also gets the final entry, on the channels they got it on.

after.title: [EN] What happens when you resolve
after.closes: [EN] The alert leaves the live list and moves to alerts that have ended. Opened from there, the final entry is on top and the thread below.
after.reach: [EN] Everyone who got any entry of this alert gets the final entry by text, on the channels they got it on.
after.stops: [EN] Nothing else is sent for this alert: texts still waiting for the other entries are cancelled, and drafts and entries waiting for approval are discarded.

approve.title: [EN] Approve an alert
approve.lead: [EN] Read exactly what residents will see and get. You approve this version only. If it changes while you read, you review it again.
approve.ambassadorLead: [EN] A building ambassador wrote this post. Read exactly what residents will see, then approve it, return it to the ambassador with a note, or discard it.
approve.ambassadorBy: [EN] Written by a building ambassador. Residents see it as from a building ambassador.
approve.drill: [EN] This is a drill. It never reaches residents.
approve.channelWeb: [EN] Web app, in every launch language.
approve.channelSms: [EN] Text messages, in the language of each person who signed up.
approve.channelDrill: [EN] The drill roster only. A drill is never shown on the web app or texted to residents.
approve.recipientsNotOpen: [EN] Text sign-up is not open yet.
approve.costNote: [EN] An estimate: segments of each text × recipients × the price per segment.
approve.fallbackSummary: [EN] {n} of {total} languages could not be translated: {languages}. They show the English text with "Translation not available".
approve.fallbackRecipients: [EN] In those languages {n} people will get the English text by text message.
approve.duplicate: [EN] This may duplicate another open alert for the same place and type.
approve.cannotEdit: [EN] You cannot change this text: whoever changes it becomes an editor and cannot approve it. To change it, return it to its author with a note.
approve.liveWeb: [EN] Residents already read this post on the web, marked "Not yet verified". Text messages go out only if you approve it.
approve.cannotEditLive: [EN] You cannot change this text: whoever changes it becomes an editor and cannot approve it. Residents already read it, so a change is a correction.
approve.discardLiveLead: [EN] Residents already read this post. Discarding it withdraws it: they see "Withdrawn" in its place, and no text message is sent.
approve.languagesLead: [EN] Open a language to read its web text and its text message exactly as residents get them.

languageStates.fallback_en: [EN] Not translated: English with "Translation not available"

approve.noSms: [EN] There is no text message in this language.
approve.approveConfirmed: [EN] Confirm the new number and approve
approve.returnHint: [EN] Say what needs to change. The author reads your note, the text stays as it is, and the author submits it again.
approve.discardLead: [EN] It is never published and cannot be brought back. The author sees that it was discarded.
approve.countChanged: [EN] The number of people who will get this text changed from {a} to {b}
approve.countChangedLanguages: [EN] The languages of the people who will get this text changed
approve.countConfirm: [EN] I have read the new number and I still want to approve.

locked.approved: [EN] This alert was approved and is published.
locked.returned: [EN] This alert was sent back to its author with a note, and is waiting for the author to submit it again.
locked.draft: [EN] Its author pulled it back to a draft, so it is not waiting for approval.
locked.own: [EN] You wrote or changed this alert, so a second person has to approve it.
locked.other: [EN] This alert is not waiting for approval.

approve.missing: [EN] That alert was not found. Open it again from the Hub.
approve.forbidden: [EN] Only a Coordinator or an Admin who did not write or change this alert can approve it.

errors.ENTRY_CHANGED: [EN] This alert changed. Review it again.
errors.VALID_UNTIL_PAST: [EN] This alert's valid-until has passed. The author must return it to draft and set a new time.
errors.EDITOR_CANNOT_APPROVE: [EN] You wrote or changed this alert, so a second person has to approve it.
errors.AAL2_REQUIRED: [EN] Approving needs a sign-in confirmed with your authenticator. Sign out, sign in again and enter your code.
errors.NOT_ALLOWED: [EN] Only a Coordinator or an Admin can approve an alert.
errors.AUTHOR_NOT_ALLOWED: [EN] Its author can no longer write this alert, because their role or buildings changed, so it cannot be approved. Return it or discard it.
errors.ENTRY_NOT_PENDING: [EN] This alert is no longer waiting for approval. Reload the page to see what happened.
errors.NOTE_REQUIRED: [EN] Write a note for the author.
errors.NOTE_TOO_LONG: [EN] The note is too long: at most {max} characters.
errors.OUT_OF_SCOPE: [EN] You cannot do that with this alert.
errors.ILLEGAL_TRANSITION: [EN] This alert is not waiting for approval.
errors.UNKNOWN_TYPE: [EN] That alert cannot be approved. Return it to its author.

approve.correctionLead: [EN] Read exactly what residents will see in place of the entry below. You approve this version only. If it changes while you read, you review it again.
approve.withdrawalLead: [EN] Read exactly what residents will read in the place of the entry below. You approve this version only. If it changes while you read, you review it again.

resetAuthenticator.lead: [EN] For a Coordinator or Admin who lost their phone. Their authenticator is removed and they are signed out on every device. They set up a new one the next time they sign in.
resetAuthenticator.doneLine: [EN] They were signed out on every device. At their next sign-in they set up a new authenticator.

providers.lead: [EN] The reviewed catalogue is loaded by the catalogue script. Here you confirm each provider and choose which ones residents see. Listing text is not edited here: it changes in the catalogue files.
providers.summary: [EN] {published} of {total} providers published. {unconfirmed} not confirmed yet.

providers.removedNote: [EN] No longer in the catalogue. It is unpublished and kept with its last-confirmed date, and cannot be published or confirmed.

directory.lead: [EN] Publishing sends every published provider to residents as one numbered release, in every language. A release is never changed afterwards: the next publish makes a new one.
directory.none: [EN] No release has been published yet. Residents see no directory until one is.
directory.publishHint: [EN] This takes a few seconds. Residents keep the current release until the new one is complete.
directory.done: [EN] Release {number} is now current. Providers: {providers}. Languages: {languages}.
directory.resumed: [EN] Files already stored when this publish continued: {files}.
directory.searchData: [EN] Search data: {vectors} providers, {reused} copied from the previous release, {embedded} made new.

directory.previousStays: [EN] The previous release is still current.

directory.inProgress: [EN] A publish is in progress: release {number}. Reload this page in a minute to see whether it finished.
directory.stalled: [EN] A publish stopped before it finished: release {number}. Press Publish directory to continue it; the files already stored are kept.
directory.catalogueMismatch: [EN] The database holds catalogue {loaded}, this deployment has {deployed}: run `npm run seed:providers` from {commit}, then publish.
directory.catalogueNeverLoaded: [EN] The database holds no loaded catalogue, this deployment has {deployed}: run `npm run seed:providers` from {commit}, then publish.

sending.lead: [EN] What became of the texts of this alert, by language. No phone numbers are shown.

sending.refresh: [EN] This page updates every 15 seconds while texts are going out.
sending.refreshDone: [EN] Nothing is waiting or in flight, so this page no longer updates by itself. Reload it to check again.

legend.title: [EN] What the counts mean
legend.waiting: [EN] Waiting: not handed to the provider yet.
legend.inFlight: [EN] In flight: handed to the provider, and the carrier has not given a final answer.
legend.delivered: [EN] Delivered: the carrier confirmed it reached the phone.
legend.undelivered: [EN] Undelivered: the carrier could not deliver it.

legend.unknown: [EN] Unknown: the outcome is unclear. It is never sent again by itself.
legend.cancelled: [EN] Cancelled: stopped before it went, by a correction, a withdrawal, a discard or a close.
legend.skipped: [EN] Skipped: it was not sent because the person left, it was too late, or texts are off in this environment.

problems.lead: [EN] Open a list to see, for each text, what happened to it.
problems.unknown: [EN] See the texts with an unknown outcome ({n})

sending.drill: [EN] This is a practice alert. What became of its texts is on the Drills page, apart from real alerts.
sending.notApproved: [EN] This entry has not been approved, so no texts have been made for it.
sending.unavailable: [EN] The sending progress could not be read just now. Reload the page. If this stays, tell IT.

list.more: [EN] Only the {n} most recent texts are shown.

resend.title: [EN] Resend texts
resend.lead: [EN] A resend sends the same words once more, to the same person, in its usual place in the queue. A text can be resent twice at most. It is counted in spend when the provider accepts it, and against the monthly cap like any other text.
resend.all: [EN] Resend the failed and undelivered texts in {language}
resend.allHint: [EN] Takes the latest text of each person in {language} that failed or was not delivered. Texts with an unknown outcome are never included: resend those one at a time, after reading the warning.

resend.confirmHint: [EN] Tick the box to resend this text anyway.

note.limit: [EN] Resent twice already, which is the most.
note.cannot: [EN] Cannot be resent: the number cannot receive texts.

done.many: [EN] {n} texts were resent. They are in the queue and go out in their usual order.
done.none: [EN] No text needed resending. Nothing was changed.

refused.cannot_receive: [EN] The provider said "{reason}", so this number cannot receive texts. Nothing was resent.

refused.recipient_not_receiving: [EN] The person no longer gets alerts, so nothing was resent.

texts.title: [EN] Pause or resume texts
texts.lead: [EN] One switch for every text that has not yet been handed to the provider. Use it to stop a mistake or a provider problem at once.
texts.running: [EN] Texts are going out as normal.
texts.whatPauseDoes: [EN] Pausing stops every text that has not yet been handed to the provider, alerts and texts to residents and to staff alike, except texts to on-call Admins. They wait in the queue and go out, in order, when you resume. A text that was already handed over cannot be called back.
texts.oncall: [EN] Texts to on-call Admins still go out during a pause, so a problem with sending is still reported.
texts.reasonHint: [EN] Everyone at the Hub sees this on every screen, with your name and the time. Up to 500 characters.
texts.resumeHint: [EN] Texts go out again in their usual order. Each one is checked once more just before it is handed over: texts of an alert that was corrected, withdrawn or closed in the meantime, or whose valid-until time has passed, are cancelled or skipped. A final alert, and the withdrawal that closed an alert, are still sent.

paused.handedOff: [EN] {n} texts were already handed to the provider and cannot be recalled
paused.handedOffOne: [EN] 1 text was already handed to the provider and cannot be recalled
paused.approver: [EN] Texts are paused; this will send when resumed

missing.what: [EN] The pause switch is missing from the database, so every text is being held.

done.waitingNone: [EN] No texts are waiting right now.
done.alreadyPaused: [EN] Texts were already paused by {name}. Nothing changed.
done.resumed: [EN] Texts resumed. {n} texts were waiting and now go out in order.
done.resumedOne: [EN] Texts resumed. 1 text was waiting and now goes out in order.
done.resumedNone: [EN] Texts resumed. No texts were waiting.

oncall.title: [EN] On-call numbers
oncall.lead: [EN] The Admins who get a text when sending is stuck or failing, so a problem is fixed before residents miss an alert. A text goes to every number on this list.
oncall.rule: [EN] Once texts are going out, no alert except a drill can be approved while this list is empty.
oncall.emptyConsequence: [EN] Add at least one before texts go live: until then no alert except a drill can be approved once texts are live.
oncall.hidden: [EN] Only the last four digits of a number are shown.
oncall.label: [EN] Name or role
oncall.labelHint: [EN] For example "IT lead". Up to 40 characters. Shown only here.
oncall.numberHint: [EN] A Canadian number, for example 416-555-0123. It is stored for sending texts and shown here only as its last four digits.

done.skipped: [EN] {n} waiting texts to that number were cancelled.

subscriptionEdit.expiredBody: هر لینک یک بار کار می‌کند، تا 30 دقیقه پس از فرستادن.
subscriptionEdit.expiredHow: برای گرفتن لینک تازه با پیام کوتاه، به یکی از پیام‌های CVH با 1 جواب دهید. اگر جواب یک مینو بود، برای بستن آن 0 بفرستید. وقتی جواب لینکی پیشنهاد کرد، 1 بفرستید.

error.invalid_request: چیزی در فورم خوانده نشد. صفحه را دوباره باز کنید و باز کوشش کنید.
error.place_unknown: یکی از ساختمان‌ها یا طبقه‌های شما دیگر در فهرست نیست. ساختمان‌های خود را ببینید و باز کوشش کنید.
error.edit_unavailable: الان نمی‌توان تغییر داد. بعداً دوباره کوشش کنید.
error.network: ما به CVH رسیده نتوانستیم. اتصال خود را ببینید و باز کوشش کنید.

offline.title: این صفحه در تلفون شما ذخیره نشده است
offline.body: این صفحه هنوز در این تلفون با سیگنال باز نشده، بنابراین به سیگنال نیاز دارد. شماره‌ها همیشه در تلفون شما ذخیره هستند.
offline.available: این‌ها را بدون سیگنال می‌توانید بخوانید
offline.none: هنوز چیز دیگری در این تلفون ذخیره نشده است. صفحه‌هایی که با سیگنال باز می‌کنید برای بعد ذخیره می‌شوند.
